text:
mira: ACME followed up: they want per-tenant SLA tiers (latency/cost), tenant-level model pinning, and a hard per-route monthly spend cap. They asked for a pilot in ~6 weeks. can we scope an MVP thats realistic?

alex: quick read: this is basically CompetitorX parity but with explicit spend caps. biggest pieces: policy surface (how customers declare tiers), gateway enforcement, billing/audit hooks, and UI for ops & sales.

sam: infra question 1: can we enforce a "monthly spend cap" without touching billing backend? maybe track usage per-route and apply soft-blocks at gateway once cap near. full hard block needs billing integration.

joan: propose a minimal policy model (YAML) customers attach to a route. example: 
```yaml
profile: platinum
preferred_model: rw-large-v2
latency_target: 250ms_p95
cost_cap_monthly_cents: 200000
fallback_sequence:
  - rw-medium-v2
  - rw-small-quant
pin_model_version: true
reporting_granularity: per_invocation
```

joan: product MVP: 1) route-level profile CRUD in Console/API, 2) gateway enforcement for per-request routing & fallback, 3) per-profile telemetry + per-tenant usage counters, 4) sales-facing simulator, 5) pilot guardrails and limits. no billing system changes in MVP (soft-blocks only).

ben: technical risks: metrics cardinality (per-tenant/per-route/per-profile) and accuracy of cost estimation for generation. also legal: we must avoid promising contractual SLAs for pilot customers. need legal signoff on wording.

tess: from sales: ACME wants a shipped pilot that they can demo to C-suite. theyre flexible on "hard blocking" if we can show predictable cost and an easy rollback. they asked for model pinning specifically to avoid silent model upgrades.

alex: implementation notes: gateway will run an estimator: input_tokens_est = heuristic(input_length); expected_cost = input_tokens_est * model_cost_rate; if expected_cost > (remaining_cap / estimated_remaining_calls) -> apply fallback or return 402-like error. record route_eval_event with fields: tenant_id, route_id, profile_name, estimate_tokens, estimate_cents, decision, fallback_model.

sam: agree. spike plan: 1wk estimator + gateway hook spike, 1wk telemetry + counters, 1wk console + API, 1wk QA/canary. can target ~4wks for core MVP; add 2wks buffer for legal and sales prep.

joan: launch criteria (pilot):
- ACME pilot region handling 50k rps/day at expected mix
- no regression in P95 for platinum beyond 300ms during pilot
- per-profile cost dashboard (1h latency) and alerting on 10% overspend trend
- per-invocation audit events retained for 90 days for disputes
- feature toggle to globally disable profiles for emergency rollback

ben: operational controls: limit profiles per-tenant to 3 for pilot, cap telemetry cardinality by sampling for low tiers, and provide an "ops override" button in Console for emergency unpin/fallback.

legal-bot: WARNING: pilot marketing language must include: "Pilot SLAs are non-contractual and for evaluation purposes only." Please have Legal review before external demo.

mira: noted. @joan please loop Legal into draft docs.

alex: SDK example (JS) we'll include in docs:
```js
await redwood.routing.createProfile({
  name: 'platinum',
  route: '/acme/ingest',
  preferred_model: 'rw-large-v2',
  cost_cap_monthly_cents: 200000,
  pin_model_version: true
});
```

sam: deploy-bot created branch feature/tenant-profiles and opened PR: https://git.internal/redwood/infra/pulls/4387

deploy-bot: CI passed for spike branch.

joan: sales simulator idea: simple web form where you paste 100 sample prompts and it shows expected monthly cost vs using fallback strategy. ben: can ops own an internal simulator for presales?

ben: yes 1 ops can own it. will estimate infra cost and storage for sample inputs.

alex: test plan: unit tests for estimator math, integration test for gateway decision tree (preferred -> fallback -> blocked), perf test to validate p95 under platinum load.

mira: action items: @sam spike by EOW + PR, @joan draft policy schema + Console mockups, @ben infra cost/cardinality, @tess sales demo materials + sample prompts from ACME, @mira coordinate legal & pilot SOW. meeting Thurs 9am to finalize. thanks :raised_hands:
